rules.statement: The maternal cousins of a deceased person can inherit the property derived from the father's side if the mother and paternal relatives are not alive.
rules.supporting_quote: "Thus, when section 27 proceeds to designate the heirs who succeed to property (a) of the estate of a deceased person on the failure of all the above persons enumerated ', the persons so 'enumerated ' have to be found by reference to sections 23 and 25 and not by reference to all the sections 23, 24, 25 and 26 as suggested by the defendant's Counsel. Those persons would be father, brothers and sisters (full or half on the father's side) and the descendants of such brothers and sisters."
